messages.subject: INLA for joint posterior distribution
parts:
Hi all,
My data contains treated and untreated groups, and each indiviudal was measured by two outcomes (binary [y1] and ordinal [y2]).  I would like to model the data jointly and obtain the joint posterior distribution of treatment effect under both outcome. I run the model in INLA and get estimated effect for the treatment indicator under each outcome (e.g., y1 and y2). Is in.posterior.sample all I need to get the samples from the joint distribution?

I hope I made me question clear. If not, I am more than happy to clarity it.

Many thanks,
Jeff
